title: ServerlessEsbuildPlugin
description: Schema for the serverless-esbuild plugin (https://github.com/floydspace/serverless-esbuild). Goes under `custom.esbuild`.

Esbuild.title: Esbuild
Esbuild.description: serverless-esbuild configuration. Standard esbuild API options (`target`, `platform`, `format`, `sourcemap`, `define`, `loader`, etc.) are also accepted and forwarded to esbuild; see https://esbuild.github.io/api/. `entryPoints`, `outDir` and `watch` are managed by the plugin and cannot be overridden.

concurrency.description: Number of concurrent bundle operations. Memory-intensive; defaults to Infinity.

zipConcurrency.description: Number of concurrent zip operations. Memory-intensive; defaults to Infinity.

disposeContext.description: Dispose of the esbuild context when finished. Default true.

config.description: Path to an external esbuild configuration file (e.g. `esbuild.config.js`).

external.description: Packages to mark as external. Forwarded to esbuild's `external` option.

exclude.description: Dependencies to exclude from the Lambda package (passed to esbuild's external). Use `*` to disable packaging node_modules.

plugins.description: Path to a file that exports esbuild plugins.

installExtraArgs.description: Extra arguments passed to npm/yarn/pnpm during external dependency resolution.

keepOutputDirectory.description: Keep the `.esbuild` output folder. Useful for debugging.

nativeZip.description: Use the system `zip` executable to create archives. Produces non-deterministic archives.

outputBuildFolder.description: Esbuild output folder name (inside the work folder).

outputWorkFolder.description: Plugin work folder name where bundles are prepared.

outputFileExtension.description: Bundled output file extension. Overrides esbuild's `outExtension`.

packagePath.description: Path to the project's package.json used for dependency resolution.

packager.description: Package manager used to install external dependencies.

packagerOptions.description: Extra options forwarded to the packager.

scripts.description: Scripts to execute. Supported for npm, yarn and pnpm.

noInstall.description: Skip running the package manager install command.

skipBuild.description: Skip rebuilding artifacts. Useful when `package` step already produced them.

skipBuildExcludeFns.description: Function names that should always be rebuilt even when `skipBuild` is true.

stripEntryResolveExtensions.description: Strip custom extensions resolved by esbuild from emitted file names.

watch.description: File-watcher configuration for `sls offline` / `sls invoke local --watch`.

pattern.description: anymatch-compatible pattern of files to watch.

ignore.description: anymatch-compatible pattern of files to ignore.
